## 6. Seeds 1 to 500

Draw: min 150, mean 204.3, max 260. Incidents: rain at doors 156, pa dropout mid-set 179, gate jam at doors 165.

Reference strategy: reference layout, $20 tickets, reference ads. "Free response" always picks the no-cost option; "best response" passes if any affordable response passes.

| Deal | Pass rate, free response | Pass rate, best response |
| --- | --- | --- |
| guarantee | 58.2% | 58.2% |
| door | 88.4% | 94.8% |

Search grid per seed: 2 deals × 7 prices × 3 ad presets × 2 layouts × every response. The highest-net strategy uses the door deal on 213 seeds and the guarantee on 287. Seeds with no passing strategy: none.
